industry_heat_def.definition_note: production-pinned definition: per SW L2, median member momentum (pct_20d_n, plus pct_60d(_n) equal-weight if present) ranked cross-industry to 0-100. Unknown L2 -> null (term contributes 0; unknown-L2 also demoted to Tier2). This ADAPTS the cross-industry-percentile industry-heat CONCEPT of runners/a_short_theme_overlay_comparison.compute_industry_heat; it is NOT a literal call to it (the overlay uses separate benchmark window-strength series unavailable in the egs_main scoring df). v1 has no SW L1 fallback.
industry_heat_def.l4_overlap_treatment: l4_score already carries small industry kickers (ind_mom_cnt>=3 +5; alpha+industry-not-falling +10). v1 keeps them intact (so the legacy profile stays byte-identical) and adds industry_heat as a separate additive term -> mild positive overlap accepted and documented; v2 may demote the l4 kickers. compute_industry_heat_score does NOT modify l4_score.

industry_trend_classifier.semantic_boundary: deterministic SW L2 price-momentum classification; LLM fundamental/policy industry judgement is a separate advisory field

promotion.theme_double_trigger: over rolling >=12 weeks: theme_double Tier1 forward 1-3wk return beats balanced by a noise-passing margin AND overheat/chasing share + realized drawdown not materially worse; then a reviewed governance change. Else never auto-promoted.
promotion.rollback_rule: if the per-run new-vs-legacy diff shows a bad delta, flip active_profile back to legacy (one-line governance change, no code)
